title: Clear five python_pkg packages under the 250-line cap
objective: Bring token_audit, focus_policy, random_jpg, app_icons and android_ui entirely under the repo-wide 250-line cap, leaving wsg_grabber as the only python_pkg package with violations.
acceptance_criteria: bash ~/utils/scripts/check_file_length.sh --all lists no file under any of the five packages.
Each package reports its exact baseline pass count: token_audit 81, focus_policy 137, random_jpg 14, app_icons 44, android_ui 57.
Every package keeps 100% branch coverage of its source modules.
AndroidUi stays defined in driver.py, since that is the only name any android_ui test patches on it.

The android_ui class split uses the mixin shape from docs/python-split-recipes.md -- ABC with abstract methods for what the concrete class supplies -- because tests call the moved methods as bound attributes of a real driver.
No assertion is changed and no test is deleted, skipped or weakened.
No suppression is added and no coverage exclusion is introduced.
out_of_scope: Changing what any test asserts, or any adb command the driver issues.
wsg_grabber's six test modules, which are a separate commit.
Changing the public re-exports in android_ui/__init__.py or app_icons' glyph names.
verifier: timeout 120 env PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m pytest python_pkg/<pkg>/tests -q for each of the five (expects 81, 137, 14, 44, 57), plus bash ~/utils/scripts/check_file_length.sh --all showing none of them, plus pre-commit run --files on the touched files.
